review_mode: Read-only artifact and source diagnosis; subsequent test corrections were made only in the separate final-repair checkout. No browser or CI rerun was performed.

findings.conclusion: A real transient responsive-state mismatch combined with measurement of that pre-update layout. This is not evidence that settled compact aliases are still too small. CSS cropping already applies at 320px while the React label still holds the wide name, wraps to two lines and consumes artwork height.
findings.observed_geometry: The failing art slots are 47.515625/47.53125 by 25.515625px. Painted long edges are 24.194–25.573px; all ordinary root viewport bounds still fit.
findings.minimal_correction: Switch the normal/compact labels in CSS in the same layout pass as the crop. Audit visible innerText and exactly one correct variant, including the 380/381 boundary. Do not lower the painted-size threshold or insert an arbitrary delay.

findings.conclusion: Genuine failure of the newly required >=30px painted-long-edge quality target in the optional 320x480 scrolling fallback. Reachable controls remain >=44px; no control-clipping failure was reported.
findings.observed_geometry: All engines produce 44x44px cells, 40x29px allocated art slots, Map ink 27.253743489583332px and Teacup ink 28.658203125px. The document is 522px tall, so vertical scrolling works but the board stays at its old 252px minimum.
findings.prior_review_gap: The previous pure metadata proof assumed a 47.515625x36.515625 slot. It did not cover the smaller 40x29 fallback slot.
findings.minimal_correction: Keep a 289px minimum board and let the tiny viewport scroll naturally, preserving supported 320x568 fit and the 30px painted-size requirement. Validate the true minimum fallback slot in pure fixtures.

findings.conclusion: The trace only records that document.activeElement.closest(dialog) is false. It does not record activeElement.tagName or document.hasFocus; actual browser-chrome versus background destination cannot be proved retroactively. No evidence identifies a focused board control.
findings.details: Three failures occur after Shift+Tab in Fresh envelope; the 430x932 case fails in Envelopes. Native Chromium sequential focus can include browser chrome, so showModal alone does not guarantee the stricter test assertion.
findings.minimal_correction: For deterministic game-modal behavior, wrap only Tab/Shift+Tab at the visible enabled first/last controls. Preserve Escape/onCancel, modifier shortcuts and opener restoration. Test both directions and record tag/name/document focus on failure.

findings.conclusion: Over-strict use of scrollHeight as a clipping proxy, not confirmed visible clipping. The 150% and 200% screenshots show the title and star; CSS allows their glyph ink to extend beyond a tight line-height:1 box.
findings.observed_geometry: At 150%, heading clientHeight 36 and scrollHeight 38; at 200%, 48/50, with the star 32/34. The actual glyph rectangles stay inside the header/viewport, and all reachable-control checks passed.
findings.minimal_correction: Use line-height:1.2 for the enlarged title/star. This is a low-risk typography correction that satisfies the existing strict metric without weakening any threshold.
